title: Packaged task scheduling smoke
minimumPromotionPolicy: Packaged task scheduling promotion requires packaged APK add/list/enable-disable/remove evidence, relaunch and task-removal cleanup archives, denial matrix coverage, user-visible disclosure, stop action, rollback, Safe downgrade, and package-identity ownership proof before the future tasks provider can be promoted.

ownershipContract.rowVisibility: packaged rows are visible only to the owning packaged app/provider until an audited user-visible task UI exists

smokeMatrix.requiredEvidence: Packaged APK resolves work_manager, declares work_manager permission, scheduleOnce/list/cancel succeeds through fake provider, shadowing is denied, and pending bridge calls return to zero.
Live Android provider schedules a packaged project entry through work_manager, executes via scheduled_runner, persists lastRun/runHistory, and can cancel the owned work.
Packaged APK add/list/enable-disable/remove over JSON-safe task database rows with package identity ownership.
Process death, relaunch, task removal cleanup, and crash recovery evidence for packaged task rows.
Install/run disclosure, foreground notification ownership, stop action, Safe downgrade, rollback, and package-scoped disable/remove evidence.
Cross-package mutation denial, missing tasks capability denial, metadata mismatch denial, and raw object denial evidence.

readyEvidence.meaning: P14-19 imports packaged work_manager schedule/list/cancel and the live packaged project-entry scheduled-runner anchor while leaving future task database rows unpromoted.
P15-12 keeps task_database unpromoted and lists task mutation, packaged mutation, disclosure, Safe downgrade, and docs blockers.
P15-13 keeps schema migration and rollback fixture-only while packaged rollback, backup, Safe downgrade, and cross-package denial archives remain open.
The task_database provider remains provider_poc until implementation, device, packaged, disclosure, rollback, security, type, docs, Safe downgrade, and raw-object denial evidence all pass.
The task_database provider declares disclosure, stop action, rollback, task-removal, relaunch, crash recovery, and Safe downgrade requirements.
P15-14 owns P14-19 under pro.tasks_device_media with packaged_smoke_archive evidence.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Packaged APK add/list/enable-disable/remove smoke over future tasks database rows with package identity ownership.
Packaged task process-death, relaunch, crash recovery, and last-run diagnostic archive.
Task removal cleanup evidence proving owned scheduled work is cancelled and package-scoped rows are disabled or removed.
Packaged disclosure, stop action, Safe downgrade, and rollback evidence for task database promotion.
Packaged cross-package add/update/remove denial evidence proving package-owned rows cannot alias main-app or legacy Rhino rows.
Missing future tasks capability and require("tasks") denial archive with stable diagnostics.
Provider-disable Safe downgrade proof that packaged task rows are preserved, disabled, or removed according to owner policy.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 sync before packaged task scheduling can be marked promoted.
